messages:
elaine: FYI opened a small PR with new examples for billing thresholds and tier behaviour — want a quick pass before I push more migration notes
marco: link?
elaine: https://staging.redwood-inference.dev/docs/pr/409 — file is docs/pricing/threshold-examples.md
priya: skimmed, initial thought: thresholds section is fine but the two examples use different units (tokens vs requests). we should standardize to tokens for consistency
cj: agree. ops teams always think in tokens for metered plans. Priya, can you suggest wording?
priya: sure. propose: "Thresholds are evaluated on billed tokens over a rolling 30-day window. Example: a 1M token/month threshold triggers once billed tokens in the last 30 days exceed 1,000,000."
marco: also suggest adding a short note on burst behavior: "Burst usage above threshold is allowed but billed at overage rates until the rolling window falls below the threshold." can be 1-sentence
elaine: adding that. also we need a tiny SDK snippet for showing how callers can read remaining quota header — I added a draft but it's JS-only. can someone drop a Python snippet?
priya: here's a quick python snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=...)
resp = client.generate(... )
remaining = resp.headers.get('X-Remaining-Tokens')
print(f'Remaining tokens: {remaining}')
```
cj: thanks. docs-bot: remember to include header names in the header reference table (X-Remaining-Tokens, X-Quota-Window-End).
docs-bot: noted — I've added a checklist comment on the PR about header table update. :white_check_mark:
elaine: one more ask: the dashboard panel screenshot I included is from staging; should we use anonymized numbers or a mock dataset? product wants realistic numbers for the doc so customers can map it to their metrics
marco: prefer realistic-ish but with a clear caption: "sample data for illustration only". avoids implying SLA or predictions
priya: also call out the difference between "allocated tier" and "effective tier" in the text — folks confused by our tiering math in previous PRs
cj: good call. can we add a tiny table? maybe two rows: allocated=500k, usage=600k -> effective tier = next slab, and show overage rate calc (0.10 per k tokens)
elaine: I added a short calculation line: "Overage = max(0, usage - allocated) * overage_rate". But needs numeric example. I'll incorporate CJ's numbers
priya: wording nit: replace 'slab' with 'tier' — external users don't use 'slab' frequently
elaine: swapped to 'tier' throughout
marco: minor link fix: the meter-to-dashboard link on line 78 points to /dash/old-panel — should go to /dash/usage-tiering. I can fix in the PR
elaine: thanks — can you push that link change? also can you confirm the staging preview URL will persist after merge? we shouldn't point docs to short-lived previews
marco: preview will expire in 48h. better to point to the example image in assets/ (I uploaded sample-dashboard.png)
elaine: done, updated image reference to assets/sample-dashboard.png
priya: approval-wise: I'm +1 on content if cj and marco are +1 on JS/Python snippets and link fixes
cj: +1 on snippets and calculation example. small push: add an inline example CLI curl showing quota headers for quick verification for SREs
elaine: added curl example: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# look for X-Remaining-Tokens and X-Quota-Window-End in response headers
```
deploy-bot: docs preview published: https://staging.redwood-inference.dev/docs/pr/409/preview (expires in 48h)
marco: will commit link fix and the header table row. then please squash-merge once CI passes
elaine: thanks everyone — I'll wait 1h for any more comments then merge. tagging this for copyedit after merge for tone/clarity @priya
priya: got it, will do a quick pass after merge
elaine: merging now. thanks all! :tada:
